name: Fall Vegetable and Chickpea Curry
description: Can be served over rice or on its own with a dollop of yogurt.

ingredients.name: Sweet Potato

ingredients.name: Zucchini

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 1 Tbsp Butter; 1 Onion, chopped; 2 Tbsp Thai Red Curry Paste; 1 Tbsp Ginger, minced; 1 large Sweet Potato, peeled and cut into half-inch chunks; 1 small Zucchini, cut into half-inch chunks; 1 Red Pepper, cut into half-inch pieces; 28 oz can Chickpeas, rinsed and drained; 1 Lime; 3 Tbsp Wheat Flour; 1 1/2 cup Milk; 1/2 cup Fresh Coriander, chopped. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Onion: chopped; Ginger: minced; Sweet Potato: large; peeled and cut into half-inch chunks; Zucchini: small; cut into half-inch chunks; Red Pepper: cut into half-inch pieces; Can Chickpeas: rinsed and drained; Coriander: Fresh; chopped. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
In a large non-stick frying pan, heat butter over medium-high heat.
Add sweet potato, zucchini, red pepper, salt, and half a cup of water.
Cook covered, stirring occasionally until vegetables soften (10 mins).
Add chickpeas and finely grated zest and juice from lime.
Stir frequently until vegetables are tender and liquid has evaporated (5 mins).
Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. A simmer means small, gentle bubbles; lower the burner if it boils vigorously.
Reduce heat to medium heat for a simmer, stirring occasionally (5 mins). A simmer means small, gentle bubbles; lower the burner if it boils vigorously.
Stir in coriander and salt if needed.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. In a large non-stick frying pan, heat butter over medium-high heat. Cook onion, stirring (2 mins). Add curry paste and ginger. Cook, stirring (1 min).
2. Add sweet potato, zucchini, red pepper, salt, and half a cup of water. Stir. Cook covered, stirring occasionally until vegetables soften (10 mins). Add chickpeas and finely grated zest and juice from lime. Stir frequently until vegetables are tender and liquid has evaporated (5 mins).
3. Whisk flour into milk. Gradually stir into pan. Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to medium heat for a simmer, stirring occasionally (5 mins).
4. Stir in coriander and salt if needed.
